description:
Doom-related tools for Java. Home of DECOHack and lots of other utilities. Build WAD projects (and soon, other kinds) with ease!

DoomTools is a set of command-line utilities for building projects or for other things related to Doom Engine games.
Changes
- 2026-08-22 ACTUALLY fix documentation folder finding via DOOMTOOLS_DOCPATH in the GUI (Issue #200).
DECOHack
Changed for 0.48.2
- Fixed Typo in EdNums warning.
DoomMake
Changed for 0.37.1
- Fixed Attempting to make an empty project will no longer cause a crash (Issue #198).
WTexScan
Changed for 1.4.0
- Added SKYDEFS parsing for sky textures and flats (Enh. #197).
